title.narrative: Baseline study of apiculture sector in Kenya

description.narrative: BEES-KENYA is a collaborative project managed by ERMIS Africa and African Conservation Foundation. The project seeks to improve livelihood and enhance food security among vulnerable groups in 5 selected Districts in Kenya which are clustered into 3 different zones for project implementation. Kenya is experiencing a rapid decline in food security due to impact of climate change and extreme weather variability. The Apiculture sub-sector has proved to be a key enterprise that contributes to improved food security, household incomes, and conservation of biological diversity - leading to improved resilience from marginalized communities against negative impacts from climate changes and extreme weather variability. A baseline survey on environmental factors, beekeeping history and practice of the communities, honey production, local challenges and carrying capacities of the available land in regard to beekeeping in the target areas will be carried out. Data on the existing registered and unregistered beekeeping groups will be documented. The availability of bee resources will be recorded in the selected areas, in order to develop interventions that can boost hive production. The survey will also document other sources of livelihoods in the target areas and effects of climatic changes.
